status: calibrated (frame-120 static calibration + per-frame drift); scale model-conditioned via params/physics.json L_c_m

conventions.world: CONTRACT: metres, Z up, origin = pivot P_ring (wire departure at bottom of the pin loop), X horizontal in the adopted swing plane toward image right, Y away from camera
conventions.pixels: CONTRACT: origin top-left corner, pixel centres at +0.5, 1920x1088
conventions.R_world_to_cv: OpenCV camera axes (x right, y down, z forward): Xc = R (X - C)
conventions.blender: camera object matrix_world rotation = R_world_to_cv^T diag(1,-1,-1); sensor_fit HORIZONTAL; shift_x = -(cx-960)/1920, shift_y = (cy-544)/1920

scale.unit: L_eff = radius of the bob-centre arc about its rotation centre P_eff (calibration gauge = 1)
scale.L_eff_m_source: params/physics.json L_eff_m.value (metres per camera.json length unit; gauge decision config/CHANGELOG.md 2026-10-25T22:47:40Z) (sha256 dc20e99c7119379f640eee4fb22b7cb405cc9495b0b659785e1742b37f093ee7), provenance model-conditioned
scale.note: all metre values below = (value in L_eff) x L_eff_m; re-run camera/write_params.py when physics L_eff_m changes. L_c (|P_ring - bob centre|) is a different length (physics.json L_c_in_L_eff_units)

reference_camera.description: reference-matched camera; static calibration on reference frame 120 (t=5.0 s); per-frame drift in 'drift' and camera/drift.csv

intrinsics.principal_point_assumption: image centre (free principal point is degenerate: runs to u=2057 px)

blender.per_frame: lens_mm, shift_x/y and roll from camera/drift.csv (use project.load_camera(frame=n) + blender_camera_settings)

drift.verdict: REAL: smooth monotonic push-in (image scale +3.30 % from frame 0 to 240, ~0.33 %/s) with a small pan; no measurable parallax between post/arm and base (similarity rms 0.3-0.8 px, affine/homography no better) -> represented as a zoom (focal-length change) + principal-point shift, camera centre fixed
evidence: measurement/summary.json camera_drift (independent, agrees: scale 1.0327 at frame 240 vs frame 0)

model.note: image-space similarity x_n = s R(rho) x_120 + t (pixels, contract convention) relative to reference frame 120, cubic polynomials in t_s fitted to camera/out/drift_similarity_raw.csv; realised in the camera as per-frame focal length s*f, principal point s R(rho) c + t and roll rho about the optical axis (extrinsic position fixed)

drift.alternative_dolly: a camera dolly of equal image scale would produce depth-dependent parallax of order 1 px between post and base front at the clip ends; not observed above 0.3 px, so the zoom representation is preferred (not proven)

locked_reference.description: drift-free diagnostic: frame-120 reference calibration held for all frames (project.load_camera(kind='locked'))

side_ortho.description: orthographic view straight along +Y onto the swing plane (true theta visible); for diagnostics

overview.description: fixed 3/4 overview, longer lens, slightly above the arm, shows swing plane obliquity and the whole stand

swing_plane.definition: phi = azimuth of the swing direction from the arm axis (+X_arm) toward +Y; world X = swing direction
swing_plane.note: bob moves toward the camera on the image-right side (apparent radius +5 % right vs left turning point)

pivot.P_eff_note: the straight lower wire lines (and the bob arc) rotate about a point ~0.08 L_eff below the pin loop; the wire bends near the loop in the AI clip. The rotation radius about P_eff is L_eff; |B - P_ring| at theta=0 is 1+e L_eff. See camera/NOTES.md (request to lead/dynamics).

stand_geometry_implied_by_calibration.boxes: base x[bx0,bx1] y[by0,by1] z[bz0,bz1]; post x[px0,px1] y[py0,py1] z[bz1,pz1]; arm x[..px1..ax1] y[-aw/2,aw/2] z[az0,az1]; rb/rp/ra = fillet radii (silhouette model)
stand_geometry_implied_by_calibration.priors: post centred on arm in Y (sd 0.01), post and arm cross-sections square (sd 15 %), fillet radius <= 0.04

uncertainty.method: spread over calibration variants (jackknife over edges, re-picked edges +-3 px, pivot weights, bob halves, free phi) camera/out/calib_variants.json; units: f px, C/dist in L_eff, angles deg
uncertainty.focal_distance_coupling: f and distance trade off along the line of sight; their ratio (image scale of the stand) is fixed to ~0.1 %

provenance_classes.f_px, R, C (in L_eff): measured (image-fitted, assumptions: pinhole, centred principal point, rectilinear stand)
provenance_classes.phi=0: assumed (within uncertainty of the free fit)
